info.name: Kesaria Jalebi
info.description: Jalebi, also known as Jilapi, zulbia, mushabak and zalabia, is a Middle Eastern sweet snack popular all over South and Western Asia. It is made by deep-frying maida flour (plain flour or all-purpose flour) batter in pretzel or circular shapes, which are then soaked in sugar syrup.

info.name: Club Kachori (4 Pieces) With Aloo Matar Sabzi Full Fry
info.description: Club Kachori is bite size mini puri prepared typically with maida,but however these kachori can be prepared with wheat flour as well.And this kachori dough call for coarsely grounded urad dal paste,chilly-ginger paste with asafoetida,hence these kachori are extremely flavourful & dangerously addictive.To pair with this kachori,a flavourful potato curry is serve.And this curry call for Panchporan,he popular Bengali spice mix,hence this potato curry taste extremely delicious with wonderful flavor.

info.description: Ras malai or rossomalai or rasamalei is a dessert originating from the Indian subcontinent. The dessert is called rossomalai in Bengali language, ras malai in Urdu and Hindi and rasa malei in Odia.
